title: Pumps: trends in InfluxDB, waveforms in MorletDB

panels.title: Vibration RMS per window
panels.description: From InfluxDB: one point per 4,096-sample window, published by MorletDB's metric bridge through Telegraf. Click a point to open that exact interval in the MorletDB viewer.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "machines") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "vibration" and r.calculation == "interval-stats-v1")
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with start_sample: string(v: r.start_sample), end_sample: string(v: r.end_sample)}))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "asset", "rms", "collection", "recording_id", "start_sample", "end_sample"])
